purpose: Pinned host runtime used only by the credential-less isolation job. Files are fetched read-only at this commit and verified by SHA-256 before use; the container adapter re-hashes them inside the image before running.
commit_note: Published remote commit. Never pin local, unpushed merge commits here. This commit predates the current 13-provider/state ABI, so harness.state stays pending until a maintainer re-pins and verifies.

harness.reason: PENDING_BINDING: the pinned host commit a450d05 predates the current 13-provider/state ABI and its file list does not include unifiedCapabilityDispatcher.js, so the adapter cannot prove it is driving the current runtime. The adapter is implemented and host-self-tested with synthetic fixtures, but it has not been executed inside this fixed image. A maintainer must re-pin a commit that contains all harness.required_files, run the isolation job successfully, then flip state to verified. Level 1-4 isolation fails closed until then; static/themes never need this pin.

verification.file_hashes: sha256 of blob bytes at commit a450d05, read with git show; no runtime code was executed to produce this pin.
verification.image_digest: fixed OCI digest; the gate refuses tag-only images and runs with --pull=never so it never downloads an unpinned image.
verification.harness_result_binding: One stdout line is HMAC-signed with a per-run stdin secret known to isolated.py and the adapter; the worker environment is a fixed minimal set. This binds output to one run and detects tampering/mixups, but it is not a complete adversarial isolation claim: candidate and adapter run under the same non-root uid. The host independently rechecks package/runtime hashes and revalidates every provider output schema (outputJson + outputSha256) from the pinned registry.
verification.does_not_prove: A pass means the declared providers ran inside the constrained container with the pinned runtime. It is not an antivirus result and does not prove the plugin harmless.
